column1: # Bridge methods of 1.5.2 jars, on top of forward/1.6.4/bridge-methods.tsv (same format, see there). 1.5.2 health, damage and knockback were ints; 1.7.10 uses floats
# (BridgeMethods converts int <-> float at the bridge and at call sites).
# a mob's maximum health was an int method the engine asked for; the shim reads it once at construction through mcc$legacyMaxHealth (and calls of the int method go there too)
# a hanging entity broke by dropItemStack() (func_82331_h in a mod built against the SRG names); 1.6.4 made it onBroken(Entity)
# --- 1.5.2 damage was an int, 1.6.4 made it a float (the same change as attackEntityFrom above): hooks mobs and armor override
# 1.7.10 passes the player first: the 1.5.2 hook (stack, target) takes the stack and the target (new parameters 0 and 2)
